ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms storage classes, retention days and the early-delete flag are declared; it does not read bucket policies.
offer: Define storage transitions and retention from the data contract. Lifecycle rules must not destroy data before its retention requirement expires.

minimal.reason: List the storage classes data moves between. Unnamed tiers make transitions unreviewable, so name each class.

mid.reason: Set retention to at least 30 days, or the data contract's period. Deleting earlier breaks the retention promise, so declare the minimum.

maximal.reason: Set deleting before retention to false. A lifecycle rule that destroys data early cannot be undone, so align expiry with retention.
